notes.title: Network Update
notes.notes:
We've reduced the amount of bandwidth required for multiplayer by only syncing the pick up and throw events.

This means that you can have more players in a game (4) but it also means differences in physics simulation will mean objects aren't guaranteed to be in the same position on all clients. In practice you probably wont notice.

You should also only use join host on a local network. Otherwise use the quick match option.

notes.title: Release candidate!
notes.notes:
The release candidate is available on the beta channel!
This version includes another new game called Honey Rush
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22269100/3a7eae606edfa6697d15ac0f4264cc9b88e0c142.jpg[/img]
As you can see it's the first joystick game in the arcade. You use the joysticks to control either side of a long pole and you have to guide a ball up a maze of holes to get to the goal. The faster you do it the more points you get.

We need people to test the release candidate ahead of the official release on the 22nd. 

We'll be at EGX on the launch day so expect some delay if you post any messages to us then. Here's what kind of swag you'll be able to grab if you're attending: http://steamcommunity.com/app/435490/discussions/0/343786746000715748/

Here's a little teaser video if you can't wait to see the new machine:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BJlFxzwKQ-g&feature=youtu.be

Future plans were posted here if you missed it:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/435490/announcements/detail/568966177036913287

"Why is X game missing?" - Don't worry, we'll be adding more content post release but we've completed all the goals in Early Access and even exceeded the target number of games as well. If you bought the game today it would feel like a complete experience.

Other changes:
[*]Fixed Rapid Fire hole state bug
[*]Tweaked claw physics
[*]Basketball physics tweak
[*]New music
[*]Graphics slider UI tweaks

Thanks for the feedback, made some more changes:
[*]Adjusted the restricted zones of some machines
[*]Honey Rush keyboard moved
[*]Honey Rush scoring and tickets adjusted
[*]Bowling pins sync correctly online
[*]Toys should appear on both player's machines online
[*]Better rotation syncing on all objects
[*]Added a "stand here" text

EDIT2:
I heard you wanted some Pierhead swag but can't make it to EGX, well you can have the next best thing and play with the beermats in VR!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9u4otyoU6c0&feature=youtu.be

[*]Much improved online syncing of objects
[*]Sync bowling scores
[*]Sync Honey Rush online
[*]Comet Drop Music
[*]Tank bullets sync online
[*]IP address is saved next time you play again

Known issues:
[*]Car doesn't appear for clients

notes.title: Quick Match and Bowling Update
notes.notes:
Pretty dull but necessary update this time.

We've added a quick match option. This will match you with a public game in your geographic region if one exists. If not then you'll host a public match and someone else might join. [strike]You'll have to back out manually if nothing happens due to ports not being forwarded for the moment. [/strike] The game will time out after 20 seconds if no connection is made. (Forward port 7777 on your routers)

We've also added a private host option for friends only.

On the bowling side we've made it so that the ball doesn't get knocked out of your hand so easily and the unwaxed portion of the alley has been made a bit less frictiony and the ball comes out of the ball return chute instead of appearing out of mid air.

We've also made it so that the toggle grip is disabled if you're already holding something to prevent accidental gripping.

[strike]Also we've recently discovered a network buffer issue which was preventing objects from syncing which we've temporarily fixed by setting everything to all costs messaging which isn't great for performance. We'll switch it back once we find out what's going on.[/strike] 

Should be working now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22269100/ca3d1f0c8eb24fcce0b12ab2f17f3814034a1cd8.jpg[/img]

First off there's a new game, the much anticipated bowling alley!

Another big addition is an entire outside section!
It's basically a fancy start menu with some nice ambience.

There's also a super cool internet radio player! Now you can play your own music if you're sick of the ambient audio. We'll add a jukebox model for it later.
Follow this link to find out how to use it:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/435490/discussions/0/352788917744853147/
Currently doesn't sync in multiplayer.

We've also added a new usability feature for people with dodgy room setups or spotty tracking in places. You can now rotate the world using the orientation compass! Press the top menu button to view the compass and release to set the new forward direction.


Other changes:
[*]Custom loading scene
[*]Added Rocketball backboard
[*]New soda can models
[*]Open and "drink" the soda cans
[*]New fonts and models for the gift shop
[*]New boxing model to prevent phantom gloves blocking paddles
[*]Experimental Touch support
[*]Outdoor view culled while inside to improve performance
[*]New twinkly stars skybox
[*]New placeholder multiplayer models
[*]Giftshop prices
[*]Various bug fixes

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Fixed infinite balls bug on several machines.

Leaderboards may be wiped occasionally up to full release as we tweak mechanics and fix bugs so get your screenshots in if you're particularly attached to your high scores.

Local scores wont be touched.

notes.title: Shooting Gallery Update
notes.notes:
NEW GAME (on the beta branch)

We've included an early look at the shooting gallery if you opt-in to the beta.
We'll change the gun model to look like an old western six shooter soon.


Other changes on beta:
[list]
[*]Added an experimental option for player scale so you can make yourself bigger/smaller for fun/accessibility.

[*]Taken another stab at fixing the Cannonball Bounce extra ball bug so comment if the game still ends when you've won an extra ball.

[*]Minor changes to UI text (we'll add a lobby area to avoid confusion later)

[*]All UI interactions are now done with the laser pointer as bashing them with the controller wasn't very accurate. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update News
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

On the opt-in beta branch we've added a new machine, Super Punch!

It's in opt-in because it's not really ready to show yet as we plan to split the game into rounds with punch patterns in the end but if you wanted to see how it looks right now you can go ahead and opt-in to the beta (under properties)

We've also added local high scores for when there's no steam connection and you want to beat your wife's scores. ːsteamhappyː
